sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER;
SELECT Name FROM GENRE ORDER BY Name;
SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM TRACK;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER WHERE Country = 'Brazil';
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';
SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice;
SELECT T2.Title FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T2.Name LIKE '%Greatest%';
SELECT ROUND(AVG(Milliseconds)/60000.0) FROM TRACK;
SELECT Name FROM TRACK WHERE Milliseconds > 120000;
SELECT g.Name AS genre_name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name;
SELECT T2.Name FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN ARTIST AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T2.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT BillingCountry AS country, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate ILIKE '2023-%';
SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDate) ORDER BY year;
SELECT T2.Title FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN ARTIST AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId WHERE T2.Name = 'AC/DC';
SELECT T2.Name FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T1.Title = 'Let There Be Rock';
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track AS T1 JOIN MediaType AS T2 ON T1.MediaTypeId = T2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY T2.Name;
SELECT AVG(Total), BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry;
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e WHERE e.ReportsTo = (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Nancy' AND LastName = 'Edwards');
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.FirstName, e.LastName;
SELECT PlaylistId, Name FROM Playlist WHERE PlaylistId IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000);
SELECT g.Name AS genre_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name;
SELECT Composer FROM Track GROUP BY Composer HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

SELECT g.Name AS genre_name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.Name AS artist_name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE t.GenreId = 2;

SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS Revenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRACK WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine);
SELECT a.Title, ROUND(a.Milliseconds/60000.0,2) AS Minutes FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId ORDER BY a.Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT T2.Name FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId GROUP BY T2.Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE Milliseconds > 300000) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_longer_than_5_minutes FROM Track;
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, e.HireDate FROM Employee e ORDER BY e.HireDate DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c WHERE c.CustomerId IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice WHERE Total > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice)) ORDER BY c.Total DESC;

SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS year, g.Name AS genre_name, COUNT(*) AS quantity_sold FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDate), g.Name ORDER BY year;

SELECT MONTH(InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS revenue, LAG(SUM(Total)) OVER (ORDER BY MONTH(InvoiceDate)) AS prev_revenue FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate)=2025 GROUP BY MONTH(InvoiceDate) ORDER BY month;

SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) / SUM(il.UnitPrice), 2) AS percentage FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, media_type_name;

SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE i.BillingYear BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025 AND t.GenreId IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY c.BillingYear;

SELECT a.Name AS artist_name, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.Milliseconds >= 60000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS avg_minutes FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.Name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_minutes DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee_name, m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS manager_name FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId;
SELECT MONTH(InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) OVER (ORDER BY MONTH(InvoiceDate)) AS running_total FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate)=2022 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack WHERE PlaylistId NOT IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries;
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE region = 'South Asia';
SELECT capital_city FROM countries WHERE name = 'Japan';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'Low income';
SELECT population FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'INR' AND year = 2023;
SELECT c.name, cs.population FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.population DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT income_group, COUNT(*) FROM countries GROUP BY income_group;
SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(population), year FROM country_stats GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;
SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE c.region = 'Sub-Saharan Africa' AND cs.year = 2023 AND cs.life_expectancy_years > 70;
SELECT year, unemployment_pct FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'DEU' AND year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2023 ORDER BY year;
SELECT c.region, AVG(cs.fertility_rate) AS avg_fertility FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3=c.iso3 WHERE cs.year=2023 GROUP BY c.region;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3=c.iso3 WHERE cs.year=2023 AND cs.gdp_usd>1000000000;
SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE c.region = 'Europe & Central Asia' AND cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.fertility_rate ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT year, gdp_usd FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2000 OR year = 2023;
SELECT c.region FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 AND cs.internet_users_pct > 70;
SELECT (population - LAG(population) OVER (ORDER BY year)) * 1000000 AS population_growth FROM country_stats WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023 AND iso3 = 'CHN';
SELECT c.name, s.year - 2000 AS gain FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON s.iso3 = c.iso3 WHERE s.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023 GROUP BY s.year, c.name ORDER BY gain DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT c.income_group, SUM(cs.gdp_usd) AS total_gdp FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3=cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year=2023 GROUP BY c.income_group ORDER BY total_gdp DESC;

SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 AND cs.gdp_per_capita_usd > (SELECT AVG(gdp_per_capita_usd) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 AND region = c.region);
SELECT AVG(life_expectancy_years) AS avg_life_expectancy FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3=c.iso3 WHERE cs.year=2023 AND cs.population<cs.year=2010;
SELECT c.name, c.region, cs.life_expectancy_years FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 AND cs.life_expectancy_years < 60;

SELECT SUM(population) AS combined_population, ROUND(100.0*SUM(population)/SUM(CASE WHEN region='Europe & Central Asia' THEN population ELSE 0 END),2) AS combined_share FROM country_stats WHERE year=2023;
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE iso3 NOT IN (SELECT iso3 FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023);
SELECT year, (gdp_usd - LAG(gdp_usd) OVER (ORDER BY year)) AS gdp_growth_pct FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'FRF' ORDER BY year;
SELECT c.income_group, c.name, cs.gdp_per_capita_usd FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.region, MEDIAN(cs.urban_population_pct) AS median_urban_pct FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3=c.iso3 WHERE cs.year=2023 GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY median_urban_pct DESC;
SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2010 AND cs.internet_users_pct < 10 AND cs.year = 2023 AND cs.internet_users_pct > 50;
SELECT c.name, AVG(cs.gdp_per_capita_usd) AS avg_gdp_per_capita FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3=c.iso3 WHERE cs.year=2023 GROUP BY c.name;
SELECT c.region, c.name, cs.population FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.population DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT c.region, c.name, s.unemployment_pct FROM countries c JOIN country_stats s ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2020 ORDER BY s.unemployment_pct DESC;

SELECT c.region, cs.year, AVG(cs.life_expectancy_years) AS avg_life_expectancy FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3=c.iso3 GROUP BY c.region, cs.year ORDER BY avg_life_expectancy DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';
SELECT DISTINCT island FROM penguins;
SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NULL;
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT AVG(body_mass_g), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT island, year, COUNT(*) AS count FROM penguins GROUP BY island, year;
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm), sex FROM penguins GROUP BY sex;
SELECT species FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY AVG(flipper_length_mm) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(bill_depth_mm), MAX(bill_depth_mm), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT species, sex, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY species, sex;
SELECT species FROM penguins WHERE body_mass_g BETWEEN (SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex='male') AND (SELECT MIN(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex='female');
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT species, AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill_length FROM penguins GROUP BY species) sub;
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN species='Gentoo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS percentage FROM penguins WHERE island='Biscoe' AND species='Gentoo';
SELECT species, year, COUNT(*) AS count FROM penguins GROUP BY species, year ORDER BY species, year;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT species) > 1;
SELECT species, ROUND(AVG(bill_length_mm/bill_depth_mm),2) AS avg_ratio FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT species, island, MAX(body_mass_g) AS max_body_mass FROM penguins GROUP BY species, island;

SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2007, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2009 FROM penguins WHERE year = 2007 INTERSECT SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2007, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2009 FROM penguins WHERE year = 2009;
SELECT species, island FROM penguins GROUP BY species, island HAVING AVG(flipper_length_mm) > (SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins);
SELECT RANK() OVER(ORDER BY AVG(bill_length_mm) DESC) AS rank, species, AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill_length FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY rank;
SELECT species, STDDEV(body_mass_g) AS stddev FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
